preregistration.data: Only past/intervening CAM_FRONT images. The original 2Hz LiDAR keyframes, point GT and scoring domains remain unchanged. New holdout stays closed.
preregistration.hypothesis: Feeding real intervening images to the existing tracker improves identity continuity compared with subsampled tracking. This is extra temporal evidence, not a new network contribution.
controls: Same BoT-SORT with all intervening causal camera frames
preregistration.detection: One frozen YOLO forward per image. Keyframe detections are shared exactly across arms. Neither arm uses ReID or a new detector.
preregistration.tracking: Separate causal GMC histories; identical matching settings, nominal lost-frame buffers 15 keyframes/90 images with an additional strict 7.5s real-timestamp expiry in both arms. Refuse gaps over 750ms; each scene starts fresh.
preregistration.scores: Full/camera point IDF1/AQ, coverage and switches at identical original keyframes; all logs, detector/GMC/tracker wall times and cold start. No semantic improvement claimed from identity alone.
preregistration.gate: At least +1 pp camera point IDF1, no full-scan point IDF1 loss, positive majority of eight logs; otherwise preserve failure without threshold tuning.
preregistration.clarification: Timestamp cap clarified before any full-rate evaluation; selection and metrics unchanged.
